The #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act would strengthen more than 30 programs that support mental health care and substance use disorder prevention, care, treatment, and recovery support services in #Philly & across the nation. I'll vote YES on this bill today.

2/ This bill would also:
✅Provide $29 million for the Healthy Food Financing Initiative, modeled on a PA program I helped to found
✅Tackle hunger and nutrition insecurity through WIC, SNAP and school meals

This #WorldStrokeDay, I want to make sure everyone knows to act F.A.S.T. to identify a stroke.

Face - Is their face fallen to one side?
Arms - Can they raise both arms?
Speech - Is it slurred?
Time to call 911!

Learn more about how to identify the signs: https://t.co/50h9y2AZFm https://t.co/Llz23w84yi
